To cover the eastern flank of his army, Howe ordered Major Robert Rogers and his Rangers to seize the village of Mamaroneck which had been recently abandoned by the Continental army. After Parsons was promoted in August 1776, command came to John Tyler, who was promoted to colonel at that time.
